summary.text: Laura Williams is a Republican state representative who has represented District 30 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She owns Wilde Creative Company, a digital marketing agency, and is vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Laura Williams was born in Houston, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas in 2015.
Her career experience includes working as the owner of Wilde Creative Company, a digital marketing agency.
Williams assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Brandon Woodard.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, Financial Institutions and Pensions, House Judiciary (vice chair), and Rules and Journal committees, as well as the Fiduciary Financial Institutions Oversight Committee.
